name: Tiny box for heat bed clips

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a simple rectangular storage box with an open top, designed to be mounted onto a surface. It features thin, uniform vertical walls and a flat solid base. The interior is completely hollowed out to maximize storage space, while the exterior is a clean, sharp-edged cuboid.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric open-top rectangular box in OpenSCAD with adjustable width, length, height, and wall thickness. The design must include a hollowed-out main body, a multi-layered lip detail at the top rim, and a mounting tab with a countersunk screw hole integrated at one of the base corners.
captions.factory: The script constructs the main box using a difference() operation between a larger outer cube and a translated inner cube based on the WIDTH, LENGTH, HEIGHT, and WALL parameters. It then creates two top border lips by subtracting smaller concentric rectangular volumes from translated thin cubes. Finally, an integrated mounting tab is built using a union of a cylinder and two cubes, which is then holed out with a difference() operation using concentric cylinders to form a countersunk screw channel.
